Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out in the middle. Sabbhineni Meghana and Shafali Verma are the openers for India. Nattaya Boochatham to start with the ball. A slip in place.
...THE CHASE...

Thailand Women started off well but after the first wicket, it was a procession, just one batter managed to get past the 10-run mark. Overall, it is a sorry show. India should chase this down without breaking a sweat. Thailand Women on the other hand will probably love to pick up a wicket or two. Can they do so? We will find out.

A really good bowling display by India or rather one can say, a dismal batting show by Thailand Women! Can't really blame them though, they might have been facing such quality bowling for the very first time. However, they will be disappointed with the two run outs, the rest though was just quality bowling. The spinners were brilliant for India, it was ideal conditions for them and they made use of it. Sneh Rana, Deepti Sharma and Rajeshwari Gayakwad together took 7 in total.

OUT! TAKEN! Meghna Singh gets the last wicket! A full toss on off, Nattaya Boochatham looks to loft it over mid off but it goes off the toe-end and it is taken by Sabbhineni Meghana. Thailand Women HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 37!
Commentary.Howout: c Sabbhineni Meghana b Meghna Singh

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, blocked.
OUT! TAKNE! Number 9 down! On middle, Thipatcha Putthawong looks to flick but this turns away. It goes off the leading edge towards cover. The fielder takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Rajeshwari Gayakwad b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, left alone.
Around off, this is guided to point.
Slows it up, lands it on off and gets it to turn away. It goes past the outside edge as Thipatcha Putthawong looks to drive.
Misfield and one! Shorter and on off, this is pushed towards cover. A misfield sees one taken.
Slower and outside off, Nattaya Boochatham pushes at it, it goes off the inside edge past the off pole and down to fine leg for one.
Overthrow! On off, this is pushed towards cover. The throw is a wayward one towards the keeper who does not collect it. A run taken.
On the stumps, kept out.
On off, defended.
Lands outside off and spins back in. Thipatcha Putthawong looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, this is hit through covers for a boundary.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
On middle, defended.
Runs, runs for Thailand Women! They need more. On middle, this is swept down to fine leg for two.
Three in a row! On off, this lands and spins away. Nattaya Boochatham looks to defend but is beaten yet again.
Another turner! Slower and fuller on off, this lands and spins away again. Nattaya Boochatham is beaten as she tries to defend.
Big turn! This lands on off and spins away. The batter is beaten as she tries to defend.
On middle, kept out.
OUT! LBW! That is plumb! Number 8 down now! On middle, this one holds its line. Stays low too. Onnicha Kamchomphu looks to pull but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal and the finger is raised.
On off, this is played to mid off.
Floats it up on off, this is swept through square leg for one.
On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Tossed up on off, defended.

OUT! LBW! Another one bites the dust! Sneh Rana has her third! This lands outside off and turns back in. Rosenan Kanoh leans forward to defend but it sneaks past the inside edge and hits the pad. An appeal and the finger is raised.
On middle, defended.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
WIDE! Fires this down the leg side. Wided.
Floats it up again around off, it lands and turns. NB is beaten again as she tries to defend.
Slows it up, lands it on off and gets it to turn away. Nattaya Boochatham is beaten as she tries to defend.
Outside off, turning away, left alone.
On middle, defended.
On middle, this is worked down to fine leg for one.

OUT! TIMBER! Rajeshwari Gayakwad strikes in her first over and Thailand Women are falling like a pack of cards! On off, pushed through. Phannita Maya looks to pull again but this one skids through and hits the off pole.
On middle, this is pulled to mid-wicket.
Slower through the air, this lands on off and turns away. Maya is beaten as she tries to pull.
Almost another one! Shorter and just outside off, Phannita Maya looks to cut but misses.
On middle, blocked.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Number 5 down! Sornnarin Tippoch steps out but this is slower and she does not get to the pitch of it. She ends up chipping it back to the left of the bowler and Rana takes a nice catch.
Outside off, left alone.
On the stumps, defended again.
On middle, this is swept through square leg for one.
On the stumps, kept out.
On off, defended.
Misfield and two! On off, this is pushed towards cover. The fielder lets it through. Two taken.

OUT! THE BAT IS ON THE LINE! Nannapat Koncharoenkai has to walk back and she will be very disappointed with that. Lazy from her! This is on off, it is jammed out to point. Nannapat Koncharoenkai takes a start and now turns back to get in. Sharma fires it towards the bowler's end and hits the stumps. An appeal and it is taken upstairs. To everyone's surprise, the batter is short.
Just short! On off, this is pushed uppishly towards cover. The fielder dives forward but it lands just short, it hits her hand and it goes towards mid off for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On off, defended.

OUT! TIMBER! That is a top nut! Almost unplayable! This lands outside off and spins back in sharply. Chanida Sutthiruang looks to defend but this sneaks through the gap between bat and pad and hits the stumps. A first-baller for her.

OUT! RUN OUT! Naruemol Chaiwai is short! The dive does not save her! On middle, Nannapat Koncharoenkai looks to work it on the leg side but this goes off the leading edge towards point. They go for one. Meghna Singh picks the ball up and fires it to the keeper who whips the bails off. It is taken upstairs and replays show that the batter is short. Thailand Women in trouble now.
Two more! Shorter and on off, this is pulled through mid-wicket for two.
A single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
On middle, defended.
A single as this is pushed down to long on.
Shorter and outside off, Naruemol Chaiwai looks to cut but misses.
On middle, defended.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Shortish again, this one stays low too, Naruemol Chaiwai looks to cut but misses.
Good length and on off, defended.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
An appeal but turned down! Outside off, Chaiwai gets outside the line of off and looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.
Shorter again and outside off, Chaiwai looks to cut but this stays low and she misses.

Edgy runs! For now, Thailand won't mind how they come as long as they do! Shorter and outside off, Naruemol Chaiwai looks to sweep, it goes off the inside edge between the legs of the keeper, down to fine leg for two.
Around off, this is guided to point.
On middle, defended.
Outside off, NC looks to push at it but misses.
A dot to end! A maiden from Meghna Singh! On off, this is guided to point.
Fuller and on off, Nannapat Koncharoenkai pushes it to mid off.
Good length and on off, this one holds in the surface. Nannapat Koncharoenkai plays a check-drive towards mid off.
Another dot! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to cover.
Around off, this is pushed to cover.
On the leg pole, Nannapat Koncharoenkai looks to heave it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On middle, defended.

OUT! TIMBER! Plays it on! First wicket for India! Sharma slows it up, bowls it wide outside off and gets it to turn back in. Natthakan Chantham looks to push at it but this stays low. It goes off the underedge and onto the stumps.
On off, defended.

FOUR! Error in judgement and a boundary! Natthakan Chantham had struck it well though. On middle, this is slog swept towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there runs in but realises it is going over, she leaps but it goes over and for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed towards mid off for one.
PUT DOWN! That was hit way too hard though! On middle, this is hammered towards mid-wicket. The fielder dives to her right and gets two hands to it but spills it. A run taken.
A single to end as this is pushed through covers.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Good length and on off, defended.
Shorter and outside off, Nannapat Koncharoenkai pushes it through covers for one.
FOUR! That is a wonderful shot for the first boundary of the game! On middle, fuller, Nannapat Koncharoenkai pushes it past mid on and this one races away to the fence.
Good length and on off, Nannapat Koncharoenkai pushes it to covers.
On the stumps, Natthakan Chantham blocks it out. Just the one from the over.
This lands outside off, and spins back in. Defended.
On middle, Natthakan Chantham works it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, Natthakan Chantham stays back and looks to defend but this skids through, it goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg.
Thailand Women and Nannapat Koncharoenkai are underway! On middle, this is hit to the right of the bowler, Sharma dives and gets a hand to it but can't stop the run as the ball rolls towards mid on.
Tossed up on off, some turn into the batter. Defended.
We are all set for the action to begin! The players make their way out to the middle. Nannapat Koncharoenkai and Natthakan Chantham are the openers. Deepti Sharma to begin. Here we go...
Naruemol Chaiwai says they would have bowled first too. Adds anything can happen but they hope they can do well. Informs they have one change.

Smriti Mandhana says it has rained and the outfield could be damp and that is why fielding could be better. States they just want to give their best, they want to finish first and all they need to do is play their best. Mentions it is a special occasion as it is her 100th T20I game. Infomrs they have one change.

Thailand Women (PLAYING XI) - Nannapat Koncharoenkai (WK), Natthakan Chantham, Naruemol Chaiwai (C), Sornnarin Tippoch, Chanida Sutthiruang, Rosenan Kanoh, Phannita Maya, Nattaya Boochatham, Onnicha Kamchomphu, Thipatcha Putthawong, Nanthita Boonsukham.

India Women (PLAYING XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana (C), Sabbhineni Meghana, Jemimah Rodrigues, Richa Ghosh (WK), Kiran Navgire, Deepti Sharma, Pooja Vastrakar, Sneh Rana, Meghna Singh, Rajeshwari Gayakwad.
TOSS - India Women have won the toss and elected to FIELD!

For those who missed it, what a game it was between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh! A vital game and it was a total humdinger. In the end, it was the Lankans who emerged victorious by a small margin and have sealed their spot in the top 4. The hosts on the other hand, need Thailand Women to lose this and then win their last game which will be played on the 10th of this month. Exciting stuff, the top 4 could well be decided on the last day of the group stage.
